name: al-agentic-dev
description: Composable AL/Business Central agentic skills: /al-steer, /al-grill-adr, /al-event-model, /al-design, /al-scope, /al-refine, /al-implement, /al-refactor, /al-mutate, /al-code-review, /al-research, /al-second-opinion. Two persistence layers: repo-root markdown (CONTEXT.md, docs/adr/, .out-of-scope/) and branch-scoped HTML specs (event-model.html + architecture.html + tasks.html). SKILLs express intent and rationale; the agent shapes output per situation. NEW in 0.25.0: /al-refine points the agent at `al-runner --guide` (the binary's own AI-targeted capability matrix) when the Pure-vs-E2E call is unclear. Hand-maintained references/al-runner.md retired in favour of the authoritative guide; /al-implement and /al-mutate ERROR-resolution paths now also direct readers to `--guide`.
